channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: In Vietnam, woman jailed for 3 years for causing fatal crash after downing 8 cans of beer and driving home
item.description: A court in Dak Lak Province, central Vietnam on Friday sentenced a woman to three years in prison for violating road traffic regulations, causing a fatal traffic accident after drinking eight cans of beer and driving home.

item.title: My first Tet in Vietnam: A ‘banh gio,’ some snacks, and a lesson learned
item.description: I still remember my first Tet (Lunar New year) in Saigon like it was yesterday.

item.title: Hanoi fashion streets packed with Tet shoppers
item.description: Fashion and cosmetics streets in Hanoi have been overwhelmed with crowds late into the night as residents rushed to buy clothes, accessories, and gifts in the final days before the Lunar New Year holiday, or Tet, due this week.

item.title: Vietnam police bust massive e-cigarette trading ring, seize 50,000 products
item.description: Police in Ha Tinh Province, north-central Vietnam broke up an interprovincial electronic cigarette trading ring, confiscating nearly 50,000 products valued at over VND8.7 billion (US$336,650), an officer said on Friday.

item.title: Vietnamese bus driver, owner fined over $8,000 for stuffing 83 passengers in 45-seater vehicle
item.description: Police confirmed on Friday they had fined a bus driver and the vehicle owner a combined VND207 million (US$8,006) after the driver was caught transporting 83 passengers in a 45-seater bus on the Noi Bai-Lao Cai Expressway in northern Vietnam.

item.title: US seeks deeper strategic cooperation with Vietnam bilaterally, regionally, globally
item.description: The United States is seeking to deepen strategic ties with Vietnam both bilaterally and in regional and global affairs, underscoring the importance Washington attaches to the two countries’ comprehensive strategic partnership, U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific Affairs Michael DeSombre said on Friday.

item.title: Three skiers killed in avalanche in France's Val d'Isere resort
item.description: PARIS - Three skiers died after being swept away in an avalanche in the upmarket French Alpine ski resort of Val d'Isere on Friday, Cedric Bonnevie, who is in charge of the resort's pistes, told reporters.

item.title: Water leak and ticket fraud charges add to Louvre woes
item.description: After a break-in and strikes, a ticket fraud scandal and a water leak on Friday brought new troubles to France's Louvre museum.

item.title: New Zealand readies for further storm damage after floods kill one person
item.description: New Zealand was bracing for more heavy rains on Saturday after floods swept through one regional centre, causing power outages, road collapses and home evacuations while a man's body was found in a vehicle submerged on a highway.

item.title: Vehicles flood Hanoi’s gateways as Lunar New Year holiday begins
item.description: Traffic surged dramatically at key gateways across Hanoi on Saturday morning, or the 27th day of the twelfth lunar month, as workers officially began their 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday and returned to their hometowns.
